title: Jesse Minter on Lamar Jackson attending voluntary workouts: I think he's excited, we'll see on April 6

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jesse Minter on Lamar Jackson attending voluntary workouts: I think he's excited, we'll see on April 6
sources.description: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said earlier this offseason that it's incumbent on the team to make players believe it is important to attend the voluntary portions of the offseason program and one of the players they'll need to persuade is quarterback Lamar Jackson.
